plainText:
A Linebacker (Japanese: フットボーラー Footballer) is a type of class introduced in Generation V. They are players of . All Linebackers are found in the Big Stadium. They mostly specialize in Pokémon and Pokémon with high Defenses.

==Trainer list==

==In animation==
 
===Pokémon the Series===
==== ====
In Lost at the Stamp Rally!, and went to the Big Stadium to watch a football game between the teams " 11" and "Team ". Although no Linebackers were seen live, two were shown on a poster telling about the big game.

According to Iris, she is a huge fan of "Gurdurr 11" because they have been training in the Village of Dragons for a long time.
 

==Trivia==
In a real game of , a Linebacker would never use a 3-point stance and no player would use a closed fist. Using a closed fist during a game could potentially disqualify them from participating.
